reviews.evidence: README ships a 16:9 Galgame conversation tab, typewriter/player input, draggable layered scene editor, preset reset/export, browser persistence, tests and Playwright smoke.
reviews.concern: Usage is brief; only one screenshot and little troubleshooting or compatibility detail.

reviews.evidence: Ships provider/model peak pricing, persistent idempotent ledger, per-call/session/global views, history, balance, alerts, WeChat operations, guarded updates and documented APIs.
reviews.concern: Normal UI workflow is spread across feature sections rather than a compact end-to-end usage guide.

reviews.evidence: Adds an Auto permission mode with sandboxed routine work, risk classification, ask/deny rules, deletion identity checks, narrow escalation and inherited child-agent policy.
reviews.concern: No concrete decision screenshots or worked approval traces; normal use is mostly policy description.

reviews.evidence: Provides 14 memory tools, inspectable Markdown storage, graph recall, review/forget policy, ten-tool imports with dedupe, settings management, keep-alive and hot reload.
reviews.concern: Tool argument examples are sparse, and the e2e test is skipped when the local Noema binary is absent.

reviews.evidence: Documents config/plugin and message rollback, vault redaction, safe mode, crash repair, timeline/diff, encrypted migration, doctor, Web/CLI rescue, rich screenshots and tests.
reviews.concern: The recovery surface is complex, but README-visible procedures, limits and failure handling are unusually complete.

reviews.evidence: The catalog itself groups linked DSH projects into browsable categories with one-line summaries, bilingual maintenance instructions and a contribution format.
reviews.concern: It states that inclusion is not verification and offers no catalog-level quality, security or maintenance checks.

reviews.evidence: Ships trajectory distillation, team sharing, multi-agent adapters, redaction, canary rollback, dashboard governance, generate/search/download/upload and SkillHub import.
reviews.concern: Team operation depends on model and embedding services; troubleshooting and concrete privacy boundaries are limited.

reviews.evidence: Ships Russian humanize/audit flows, 56 patterns, 40 A/B markers, soft-signal and source checks, CLI/DSH/CI use, before-after demo, offline action and extensive gates.
reviews.concern: The README is dense, and detector reduction is explicitly non-guaranteed with contextual false positives.

reviews.evidence: Ships eight themes, local/URL/gradient wallpapers, blur/opacity, accents, theme-pack import/export/share, local library, favorites/random, validation rollback and many previews.
reviews.concern: Preferences are browser-local, compatibility is pinned to an RC line, and first-frame flashing remains unresolved.

reviews.evidence: Imports 18 agent formats through UI or tools, preserves tool/reasoning metadata for resume, exports to three formats and offers optional bidirectional incremental sync.
reviews.concern: README has one promo image and little direct compatibility, validation, failure, privacy or troubleshooting evidence.
